title: Project files
subtitle: The files behind your agents, benchmarks and release rules. Edit them here; every save keeps the old version.

sync.title: Sync with your machine
sync.body: Keep a copy of this project on your computer that matches the server. Set HEIMDALL_TOKEN to an API token, then run:
sync.rules: pull never overwrites a file you changed since the last sync, and push never overwrites a file changed here; both list the clashes and stop. Add -force to overwrite. Files up to 64 MiB sync; files over 1 MiB keep no old versions.
sync.tokenLink: Create an API token (Settings, API tokens)
sync.localToken: On a local server the token is its write token (BENCH_WRITE_TOKEN); pull works without one.
sync.summary: Sync with your computer using the command line

empty: This folder is empty. Create a file or upload a zip.
badName: Use a relative name without ".." or a leading slash.
readOnly: You can only read here. Ask an admin for the member role to edit.

editor.newFile: New file: it is created when you save.
editor.binary: This file is binary and cannot be edited here.
editor.conflict: The file changed since you opened it. Reload to get the latest version, then apply your edit again.

emptyViewer: This folder is empty. A member can add files here or from the catalog.
pickFile: Pick a file on the left, or create a new one.
